name: Objective-C
note: Smalltalk-style message passing layered on top of C
typeSystem: A static C type system extended with dynamic, Smalltalk-style message dispatch: the id type erases static class information so any object can receive any message, resolved dynamically at runtime, while ordinary C types remain statically checked.
runtime: Compiled ahead-of-time to native code via Clang/LLVM. Modern Apple projects commonly enable compiler-provided Automatic Reference Counting (ARC), but ARC is optional per translation unit and manual retain/release remains a supported model.

runtimes.name: Native (Clang/LLVM)
runtimes.role: AOT compiled; the Objective-C runtime provides dynamic message dispatch and reference-counting operations, while the compiler inserts ownership operations when ARC is enabled.

compilers.name: Clang
compilers.role: The modern reference compiler for Objective-C, part of LLVM.

compilers.name: GCC
compilers.role: Earlier compiler used before Clang became the de facto standard on Apple platforms.

concurrencyModel: Objective-C itself adds no general concurrency model to C. On Apple platforms, Grand Central Dispatch queues and OperationQueue are the idiomatic framework facilities, alongside lower-level POSIX threads.
